summary: Frontend-only regression test of the Light Sentinel UI redesign session on Home (Quick Checks strip + All checks expand/collapse), Patrol (state-colored filter chips), and Ask (gold pending indicator + gold left-accent Apollo bubble), plus general regression on Guard/Settings and bottom-nav. All acceptance criteria verified via browser automation and passed. No backend tests run per request (backend unmodified this session); the live /api/ask/stream integration was exercised as part of Ask flow testing and worked end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx: Quick Checks strip correctly implemented as a single panel with dividers (no per-item boxes), gold unboxed icons for primary 4, navy icons for the 6 'more' checks -- matches design intent in code comments.

patrol.tsx: filter chip active color now correctly derived per-state via toneColor()/toneTint() instead of a hardcoded green, confirmed visually (Barking=red rgb(217,83,79), Growling=orange rgb(232,148,58), Patrolling/resting=green rgb(79,175,131)).
ask.tsx: Apollo bubble border-left color confirmed gold (rgb(201,163,74)); ActivityIndicator uses colors.gold for pending state.
No regressions found in guard.tsx/settings.tsx (untouched this session) -- confirmed by rendering + protection toggle interaction.

success_rate.backend: not tested (out of scope this session)

seed_data_creation: None -- tested with a fresh device (0 patrol events), so filter chip color behavior was verified via computed border-color rather than actual event-list filtering (no seeded events existed to filter against).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via browser automation at mobile viewport (375x667): (1) Home Quick Checks strip renders 4 primary gold-icon items with thin dividers, no individual card boxes; 'All checks' toggle expands 2 more divided rows (6 items, navy icons) and label flips to 'Fewer checks', collapse works and hides testID home-all-checks; all 10 quick-check testIDs navigate to correct routes (/check, /message, /call, /scan, etc.). (2) Patrol filter chips: tapping Barking/Growling/Patrolling(resting) shows distinct meaningful border/tint colors matching each state (not a single green), confirmed via getComputedStyle. (3) Ask tab: sent message via ask-input + ask-send-button, streamed a real reply from /api/ask/stream, pending spinner is gold-colored, Apollo reply bubble has gold left-accent border. (4) Guard tab renders correctly, protection toggle switch (role=switch) works, flips card to 'Apollo is guarding what he can' with green Requested:on badge. (5) Settings tab renders correctly with privacy info and anonymous device ID. (6) Bottom nav Home/Guard/Patrol/Higgins/Settings all show gold icon+label when active, navy bar otherwise -- consistent across all 5 tabs. (7) No blank screen, no red screen, no console errors observed; app booted cleanly onboarding->tabs via localStorage 'apollo.setup.done' flag as documented. MOCK badges/adapter behavior as expected, not a bug.
